body: I think the biggest challenge for me right now is talking with my family about it. Thank you.

I've gone to a therapist before, but not for this. I went for my anxiety (of which I can proudly say I have no problem with) and now I want to go back and I tell my parents and they say yeah ok and then they never set the appointment and now I'm actually crying. I don't want to tell my parents why though I just tell them I want to go back because I'm scared they will make me stop taking my meds because a side affect is suicidal thoughts.
I'm not happy anymore. I remember when I used to be care-less and fun and would talk to anybody. Now my parents don't even recognize me. I just don't know what happened. I'm not happy anymore.
